chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Walid, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me from his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying while standing near the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): "I beseech Allah Who selected you, chose you, purified you, guided you, and through you guided others, to send blessings upon you."
Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with a complete salutation.

key_terms.أصفاك: Purified you (asfaka) - spiritual purification and cleansing
key_terms.اصطفاك: Chose you (istafaka) - divine preferment and election
key_terms.انتجبك: Selected you (intajabaka) - divine selection and appointment
key_terms.يصلون على النبي: Send blessings upon the Prophet - the act of salawat

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say at the Prophet's grave?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) was witnessed by Ishaq ibn Ammar supplicating at the Prophet's grave in Medina, invoking Allah by His acts of selecting, choosing, purifying, and guiding the Prophet, and asking Him to send blessings upon him. He then recited Quran 33:56, which commands believers to send blessings upon the Prophet. This narration demonstrates the etiquette of visiting the Prophet's grave and the practice of the Imams in honoring the Prophet through supplication.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
